rv.q: Sharp performances from the cast, particularly by Glenister and Townsend, propel the story forwards at speed.

Together they make this revival of Mamet’s 1983 classic, Glengarry Glen Ross, a masterclass in testosterone-fuelled acting. From its haunting title, to its moments of explosive dialogue, this is a modern classic, which when it was first staged won Mamet the Pulitzer Prize.

cn.t: Mamet's caustic 1983 takedown of toxic masculinity and ruthless capitalism still thrills in star-studded revivals that bring surprising humanity to the cutthroat world of real estate salesmen.
